title: Kissed Algerian Shrimp Paella
description: A fatty, juicy date-night dish featuring shrimp, lardons-rendered fat, and a variety of aromatic spices for an authentic yet modern twist on traditional paella.

ingredients.name: Optional: 4 ounces smoked gouda cheese, grated (for topping)

instructions: In a large skillet, sauté onion and garlic in lardons-rendered fat until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add rice, stir well, then pour in chicken broth. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 18-20 minutes or until liquid is absorbed.
Stir in saffron threads, remaining lardons-rendered fat (if not used), peas, lemon zest, salt, and pepper.
Mix in chopped parsley. If using cheese, top with grated gouda before serving.
Serve hot as a hearty main course.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
